# ConsultYourCA AI

> AI co-pilot built for Indian Chartered Accountants and CA students — answers tax questions with cited Income Tax Act, GST Act and Companies Act sections, drafts notice replies, client emails and case-law summaries.

ConsultYourCA AI is an Indian tax-focused AI assistant. Unlike general AI tools, every answer cites the exact section, rule and circular it's based on (e.g. Section 10(13A), Rule 2A, CBDT Circular No. 8/2013), tuned for the Income Tax Act, GST Act, Companies Act, ICAI standards and recent CBDT/CBIC circulars.
